statements.attributed: L-PPF fabrication method applied to eutectic high-entropy alloy (EHEA) AlCoCrFeNi2.1 resulted in a unique nanolamellar morphology consisting of alternating layers of body-centered cubic (BCC) and face-centered cubic phases (FCC)
statements.quote: Recently, the L-PPF fabrication method has been applied to eutectic high-entropy alloy (EHEA) AlCoCrFeNi2.1 resulting in a unique nanolamellar morphology consisting of alternating layers of body-centered cubic (BCC) and face-centered cubic phases (FCC).

statements.attributed: nanoscale morphology and mixture of two BCC/FCC phases results in extremely high yield strength of 1.3 GPa and a large uniform elongation of 14% under uniaxial tensile stress
statements.quote: The nanoscale morphology and mixture of two BCC/FCC phases results in extremely high yield strength of 1.3 GPa and a large uniform elongation of 14% under uniaxial tensile stress.

statements.cited_system: B2 phase and its transformed phase
statements.quote: Notably, the initial interphase boundary between FCC and B2 phase remains essentially stationary, and the crystallographic orientations of initial B2 phase and its transformed phase conform to {111}FCC || {110}BCC and < 110 > FCC || <111 > BCC, following the classic K-S transition path.
